correctness.rationale: Reconstructed exact exhaustion using a fresh word-prefix implementation: anchor at the unique 00000 factor; append both possible bits unless the new trailing five-window has appeared; at length 32, test the four remaining wrap windows against the mask. Every admissible anchored word has a surviving prefix at every step and is uniquely represented. For each cut, the XOR of the cut word with its right shift h, masked to 32−h aligned positions, counts disagreements, so 32−h minus twice its popcount is the non-wrapping correlation. Exact evaluation at all 32 cuts and 31 lags on each of 2048 words matched all 11 histogram entries, exact moments 3609/512 and 1103247/262144, both cited representatives, the 24/8 optimal-cut split, and 8/2 extremal orbits all of size four. The reversal/complement action was computed after rotation canonicalization. The cyclic identity also holds by start-index partition and reindexing the crossing products; it does not specify the two terms separately. The frozen checker was inspected, not executed.
residual_risks: The computation and its completeness arguments are specific to binary order five. The independent replay establishes the mathematics, not priority or novelty.

value.rationale: The invariant itself is natural: binary order five is a standard complete comparison population and an unknown best-cut peak spectrum would benchmark finite non-wrapping sidelobes distinct from periodic ones. But the complete central table and cut split already have verified identical coverage; the moments are routine, and the remaining counts of reversal/complement orbits of the already covered extreme classes are not developed as a distinct, substantively motivated mathematical finding. Recomputing the table accurately is useful corroboration, not a new scientific contribution of the frozen claim.
residual_risks: This does not characterize the value of a genuinely new and independently motivated symmetry or higher-order statistic. No such repaired claim was delivered.
